text.p: Medtronic Inc said Monday it received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its Sprint Model 6942 tachyarrhythmia lead.
The Medtronic Sprint Model 6942 joins the Sprint Model 6932 released last August.

Positioned in the heart and flexing each time the heart beats, leads are crucial to device therapy for cardiac arrhythmias, Medtronic said. A lead transmits signals to the implanted defibrillator about the activity of the heart's electrical conduction system and also delivers therapeutic impulses that return the heart to normal rhythm.

"The introduction of the Model 6942 lead increases the options available to physicians as they optimize the performance of any implanted defibrillator system," Jon Tremmel, president of the Medtronic Tachyarrhythmia Business, said in a statement.
The third member of the Sprint family, the Model 6943 lead, is currently in clinical evaluation.
